review_evidence: The README describes a type-safe deeply embedded SQL query DSL using intrinsically typed GADTs and PHOAS binders so only well-formed SQL elaborates.

A scan of the 42 Lean files found 93 theorem/lemma/example/axiom declarations; LeanLinq/Theorems.lean contains results such as Query.evalRows_limitC_length_le, Query.run_limit_length_le, and Query.run_gcard.
The tests and Playground also contain typed examples and propositions exercising the semantics, so path-based test exclusion would discard useful formal API evidence.
summary: Retain lean-linq: its typed SQL embedding includes explicit semantic/cardinality theorems and proof-bearing query infrastructure.
